name: SapiensQ Agentic Bank sandbox
install: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.3 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm seed

terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Runs the Hono API on http://localhost:3001 and the Vite web UI on http://localhost:5173 in parallel (make dev). The API also serves /trust-demo and mounts a local Ganache EVM chain for the Trust Layer.
